summary.en: Combine borrowing rules, typed collections and validated file storage in a console application.
summary.bn: ক্লাস, কালেকশন আর ফাইল স্টোরেজ মিলিয়ে মেনু দিয়ে চালানো লাইব্রেরি অ্যাপ বানাও।

notes: Java 17 console application; persistence uses UTF-8 text, not Java object serialization.

sections.title: Keep a defined UTF-8 record format
Keep identity and commit boundaries intact
Extend one rule at a time
Integrate contracts rather than only features

examples.title: Menu-driven borrowing with a save and reload
examples.explanationHtml: The catalog is keyed by unique ID. Loading stages validated records before replacing the current state; saving writes a staging file before moving it over the target.

practice.title: Exercise the catalog from commands
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..30), then n command lines. ADD id title creates a book (positive id at most 1000, title of 1..40 printable ASCII characters excluding |). BORROW id and RETURN id change loans; LIST prints the catalog. Inputs follow this grammar. Print the same status words as the project: ADDED/DUPLICATE, BORROWED/UNAVAILABLE/MISSING, RETURNED/NOT_BORROWED/MISSING. LIST prints EMPTY or BOOK id title IN/OUT, in ascending id order. Do not print a menu.
hints: Use the same domain transitions; keep the console grammar outside Book.

practice.title: Prove a round trip
practice.statementHtml: Describe a test showing that saving and loading restores both titles and loan status.
practice.answerHtml: Create IDs 7 and 2, borrow 7, save, then return 7 and add ID 9. Load the saved file. The catalog must contain only IDs 2 and 7 in order, with 7 OUT and 2 IN. This checks replacement rather than accidental merging.
hints: Change live state after saving so restoration is observable.

practice.title: Reject a damaged file without losing the catalog
practice.statementHtml: Design a test for a file with one valid record followed by a duplicate ID or malformed status.
practice.answerHtml: Start with a known live catalog. Load into a separate map, validating each ID, title and exact boolean field. A later invalid row must throw before books is assigned. Verify that the original live catalog remains unchanged.
hints: A failure halfway through reading is the revealing case.

quiz.prompt: Why does the library use a map keyed by book ID?
options: To enforce one catalog entry per ID
To allow duplicate IDs by default
quiz.explanation: putIfAbsent rejects duplicates without overwriting the existing book.

quiz.prompt: Which relationship connects Book to LibraryItem?
quiz.explanation: Book is a specialized catalog item and overrides kind.

quiz.prompt: Why does Book also implement Loanable?
options: To create a second class superclass
To state borrowing and returning capabilities
quiz.explanation: The interface specifies behaviour independently of the item base class.

quiz.prompt: What must a second borrow request for an OUT book return?
quiz.explanation: A repeated borrow cannot make another successful transition.

quiz.prompt: What is the load method’s commit point?
options: Assigning books after the full file validates
Clearing books before opening the file
quiz.explanation: The temporary map protects current state until complete validation succeeds.

quiz.prompt: What is preserved in each saved record?
quiz.explanation: The three fields are enough to reconstruct this project’s book state.

quiz.prompt: What does the default no-argument demonstration do with its storage file?
options: Overwrites a fixed user library file
Stores data in the source code
Creates a private temporary file and removes it on exit
quiz.explanation: Pass a deliberate file path argument when persistent storage is wanted.

quiz.prompt: Does moving the staging file with REPLACE_EXISTING promise crash-safe atomic storage?
options: Only if the title is short
Yes, because a map is sorted
No; the move is not requested as atomic
quiz.explanation: The design reduces partial write exposure but makes no crash-consistency guarantee.

keyPoints.en: Keep catalog identity separate from display titles.
keyPoints.bn: বইয়ের আইডি আর দেখানোর টাইটেল আলাদা রাখো।

keyPoints.en: Book models a catalog item and a borrowing capability.
keyPoints.bn: Book একটি লাইব্রেরি আইটেম, আর Loanable তার ধার দেওয়ার কাজ বোঝায়।

keyPoints.en: Collections enforce ID uniqueness and report order.
keyPoints.bn: কালেকশন দিয়ে আইডির ইউনিক নিয়ম আর রিপোর্টের অর্ডার ঠিক রাখো।

keyPoints.en: File loading should commit only after complete validation.
keyPoints.bn: ফাইল পুরো যাচাই শেষ হলে তবেই ক্যাটালগ বদলাও।

keyPoints.en: Console parsing belongs outside domain objects.
keyPoints.bn: কনসোলের কমান্ড পড়ার কোড ডোমেইন অবজেক্টের বাইরে রাখো।

examQuestions.question: Draw the project classes and explain each relationship.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
Book --|> LibraryItem
Book ..|> Loanable
Library 1 ---- 0..* Book
Main --> Library

The hollow triangle denotes inheritance; the dotted triangle denotes interface realization. Library indexes books and coordinates requests. Main owns parsing and presentation. LibraryItem stores common identity; Loanable names a capability.

examQuestions.question: Explain the save/load format and its validation boundaries.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Each UTF-8 line is id|title|borrowed. IDs are positive and unique; titles are nonblank and exclude the delimiter and newlines; borrowed is exactly true or false. Load into a separate map. Saving closes a staging writer before moving the file into place. General escaping, concurrent writers and crash recovery require a richer design.

examQuestions.question: Propose extensions without breaking the current Book borrowing contract.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Add a reference-only LibraryItem subclass that does not implement Loanable. At a broader catalog boundary, test capabilities or separate borrowable items. Add member and loan records for borrower identity and due dates. Preserve the rule that an already borrowed item cannot be successfully borrowed again.
